chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Sulayman al-Hammar, from Burayd al-'Ijli, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding a man whose backbone was broken so that he was unable to sit, that the diyah is due for it.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام as the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الدِّيَةَ: financial compensation due for bodily injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on diyah for a person whose backbone is broken and he can no longer sit?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning severe bodily injury. It establishes that if a person's backbone is broken to the point that he cannot sit, the full diyah is payable for that injury.
